task: Two technical solution documents sit in different folders — one on feature compatibility under Images, one on process optimisation under Downloads. Identify the product risks each implies, then produce a single pre-launch validation checklist covering both so the two do not conflict when they ship together. Note any risk that only becomes visible when the two are read side by side, since those are the ones neither author could have caught alone. Where the two documents assume different behaviour from the same component, say which assumption the rest of the product is built on, because one of the two solutions will have to give way and it is cheaper to know which before either ships.
